title: Am I a SMURF?
not_playable_reason: Not a variant: normal rated online chess vs ~2000 humans to test whether he is underrated.
summary: After friend Jack (jacksark) doubted his 2100 rating, the narrator plays many normal rated 3-minute games on chess.com against ~2000-2080 humans (timmy8484 1989, Jadambrad1985 2076, Revenet 2033) to see whether his rating climbs or collapses. Standard chess throughout.
